about:
I'm a Computer Engineering student at the University of Waterloo with a passion for building robots that interact naturally with humans. My work spans the full stack of robotics—from designing custom PCBs and 3D-printed mechanisms to implementing GPU-accelerated AI pipelines with LLMs and computer vision.

I've built everything from gesture-controlled robot arms using AR glasses to expressive robot heads that can hold conversations. When I'm not soldering or debugging ROS2 nodes, you'll find me competing at hackathons or tinkering with new sensor technologies.

experience.description: Captures multi-modal teleoperation data (Quest 3, Vive, Manus gloves) into LeRobot datasets to fine-tune the RLDX-1 foundation model. Builds feasibility proofs-of-concept with the AWS Prototyping team, and mobile-base teleop, auto-homing and state recovery for robot controllers.

YC S24. Shipped Red Teaming, an adversarial voice-agent evaluation suite with an adaptive attack selector on Temporal workflows. Built a dual-mode in-app chatbot for navigation and root-cause analysis over call data.

Designed lightweight exoskeleton wrist controller with Dynamixel actuators. Built multi-camera AprilTag tracking system with 20% accuracy improvement. Developed interactive Three.js web interface for remote calibration.
Designed and routed double-layer PCBs for controller subsystem. Maintained 0 ERC/DRC violations across all layers. Soldered and tested multiple SMD boards including IMU and power control circuits.

Developed and deployed client-facing e-commerce sites on Wix and Shopify. Reduced handover time with modular templates and simplified CMS workflows. Created cohesive brand identity with custom graphics.
